info.title: Noema Crystal API
info.description: The crystal `/v1` REST surface: run flows, discover flows, observe runs. This document is generated from the in-code API contract — do not edit by hand.

post.summary: Invoke a flow and return its run handle.

run.description: The public projection of a run (Actum). JSON-safe and stable.

exitus.description: The outputs produced by the run — present only when available.

failure.description: Populated only when the run failed.

cost.description: Impetus cost, serialised as a string.

createdAt.description: When the run started, as an ISO-8601 string.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

schema.description: Invoke a flow. Provide a target (one of modusId or verb) and the inputs (aditus). Anonymous callers may carry a `commitment`; web3 callers a `web3` bundle.

modusId.description: Explicit flow id to run (wins over verb).

verb.description: A canon verb to resolve to a flow.

aditus.description: The flow's inputs, keyed per its input JSON-Schema (see GET /v1/flows/:id).

maxImpetus.description: Hard spend cap — admission refuses if the estimated reservation exceeds this value.

studioId.description: Target an existing warm studio (a Modo session) instead of cold-provisioning a pod.

webhookUrl.description: Fire-and-forget completion POST target — receives the terminal run event.

get.summary: Fetch a run by id (poll for completion).

run.description: The public projection of a run (Actum). JSON-safe and stable.

exitus.description: The outputs produced by the run — present only when available.

failure.description: Populated only when the run failed.

cost.description: Impetus cost, serialised as a string.

createdAt.description: When the run started, as an ISO-8601 string.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

get.summary: Server-Sent Events stream of run events (an initial snapshot, then progress/stage/complete/failed frames). Content-Type: text/event-stream; the stream ends on the terminal event.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

get.summary: The live OpenAPI 3.1 description of this surface (self-describing).

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

post.summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) JSON-RPC endpoint — agent tool-use over the same facade. Tools: run_flow / get_run / list_flows / describe_flow / collect / get_collection. Resources: crystal://flows and crystal://flows/{id}. Stateless streamable-HTTP transport; not a typed REST op.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).
A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

post.summary: Save a reusable owner-keyed flow derived from an owned run (fromRun) or a base flow (modusId).

schema.description: The id of the newly created flow.

id.description: The slug id of the saved flow.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

schema.description: Save a reusable owner-keyed flow derived from an owned run or a base flow.

fromRun.description: Derive from an owned run (copies its modusId + aditus).

modusId.description: Derive from an explicit base flow id.

name.description: Human-readable name; yields a global-unique slug.

aditus.description: Input defaults to bake into the saved flow.

promptMode.description: Whether the prompt field is open or pinned.

affix.description: Prompt prefix/suffix to fold into every run of this flow.

pinnedModels.description: Model pins baked into the saved flow.

schema.description: A flow's JSON-Schema description — read this before invoking; never guess inputs.

input.description: The flow's input JSON-Schema (the shape of `aditus`).

output.description: The flow's output JSON-Schema — present when the flow declares one.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

post.summary: Estimate a run cost (impetus) without dispatching — call before invoke to budget.

schema.description: The estimated impetus cost for the run.

impetus.description: Upper-bound reservation cost, serialised as a string.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

schema.description: Estimate a run cost without dispatching. Provide a target (modusId or verb) and inputs.

modusId.description: Explicit flow id to quote (wins over verb).

verb.description: A canon verb to resolve to a flow.

aditus.description: The flow's inputs — same shape as POST /runs aditus.

get.summary: List the canonical compute substrates (fundamenta) available for flows.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

get.summary: Browse the model weight catalog, optionally filtered by genus, basis, fundamentumId, trigger, or free-text query.

basis.description: Base model family this weight is compatible with.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

put.summary: Rebind a canon verb (make, chat) to a specific flow for the authenticated caller.

modusId.description: The flow it now resolves to.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

schema.description: Rebind a canon verb to a specific flow.

modusId.description: The flow id to bind this verb to.

get.summary: Return the authenticated caller's account snapshot — balance, in-flight gens, and studios.

schema.description: The caller's account snapshot — balance, in-flight gens, studios.

balanceImpetus.description: Spendable impetus balance, serialised as a string.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

post.summary: Lease a hosted warm studio (a persistent GPU session) for fast repeated runs. Returns a provisioning handle immediately; poll GET /v1/studios/:id (or set options.webhookUrl). maxImpetus is the session budget — the studio drain-terminates at the cap.

studio.description: A hosted studio. `studioId` is what POST /v1/runs { studioId } targets.

studioId.description: The studio id (a Modo session) — pass as run.studioId.

status.description: Pod-derived liveness: idle | running | provisioning | draining | terminated.

gpu.description: GPU model the studio runs on.

budgetImpetus.description: The authorized session budget (the maxImpetus cap), as a string.

costPerHr.description: The pod's real hourly USD cost — the source of truth for warm-time billing.

impetusPerSecond.description: Coarse burn-rate hint (impetus/sec); billing is per-window from costPerHr. Prefer costPerHr for an accurate rate.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

schema.description: Lease a hosted warm studio. Everything is optional — the simplest call leases a default studio capped at the balance. Discover fundamentumId via GET /v1/fundamenta and models via GET /v1/models (no opaque ids).

fundamentumId.description: Compute substrate to arm on (its runtime is inherited). Enumerate via GET /v1/fundamenta.

models.description: Model ids (intellaId) to install live onto the studio. Enumerate via GET /v1/models.

warmMs.description: How long to hold the studio warm (ms).

maxImpetus.description: Hard spend cap = the session budget (impetus). The studio drain-terminates at the cap. Omitted → the full balance.

runtime.description: Override the on-pod runtime explicitly (else inherited from the fundamentum).

webhookUrl.description: Fire-and-forget POST when the studio is ready (or failed) — sugar over polling GET /v1/studios/:id.

get.summary: List the authenticated caller's live hosted studios.

items.description: A hosted studio. `studioId` is what POST /v1/runs { studioId } targets.

studioId.description: The studio id (a Modo session) — pass as run.studioId.

status.description: Pod-derived liveness: idle | running | provisioning | draining | terminated.

gpu.description: GPU model the studio runs on.

budgetImpetus.description: The authorized session budget (the maxImpetus cap), as a string.

costPerHr.description: The pod's real hourly USD cost — the source of truth for warm-time billing.

impetusPerSecond.description: Coarse burn-rate hint (impetus/sec); billing is per-window from costPerHr. Prefer costPerHr for an accurate rate.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

get.summary: Fetch one of the caller's studios by id (owner-scoped) — poll its status (provisioning → idle) after provisioning.

studio.description: A hosted studio. `studioId` is what POST /v1/runs { studioId } targets.

status.description: Pod-derived liveness: idle | running | provisioning | draining | terminated.

gpu.description: GPU model the studio runs on.

budgetImpetus.description: The authorized session budget (the maxImpetus cap), as a string.

costPerHr.description: The pod's real hourly USD cost — the source of truth for warm-time billing.

impetusPerSecond.description: Coarse burn-rate hint (impetus/sec); billing is per-window from costPerHr. Prefer costPerHr for an accurate rate.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

post.summary: Start a Collection — expand one flow over a Tractus[] parameter grid into `total` pieces (general batch / NFT-collection generation). With `draft:true` it is created but NOT fired (author tractus, then POST /:id/fire). Returns a Collection handle (poll GET /v1/collectiones/:id).

collection.description: The public projection of a Collectio (a generated collection / batch). JSON-safe and stable.

status.description: The collection lifecycle status. `draft` = authored but not yet fired (tractus still editable).

modusId.description: The flow (modus) expanded across the grid.

total.description: Target piece count (the size of the run).

provenanceHash.description: Content-address of the generative config (`sha256:<hex>`) — the NFT provenance hash.

items.description: One axis of variation — the aditus port to vary and its options.

porta.description: The aditus port key this axis varies (e.g. background, outfit).

label.description: Human-facing category label (falls back to porta).

items.description: One option within a trait axis.

value.description: The aditus value injected when this option is selected.

label.description: Human-facing display name (falls back to String(value)).

rarity.description: Probability weight for weighted-random selection (default 0.5; higher = more common).

promptFragment.description: Text woven into the assembled prompt when this option wins.

excludes.description: Labels in OTHER axes this option blocks.

tags.description: Theme tags for group-level mutual exclusion.

tractus.description: The trait axes + values (the parameter grid) — exposed for the garden/rules authoring surfaces. Frozen once fired.

reviewEnabled.description: Whether each piece is held for review before it counts.

owners.description: Per-artifact ownership split (team-owned collections only) — weights sum to 1.

completed.description: Pieces completed so far (approved, when review is on).

failed.description: Pieces that failed to generate so far.

rejected.description: Pieces a reviewer rejected so far (distinct from failed).

cost.description: Total impetus across completed pieces, serialised as a string.

default.description: A request error (see the Error schema and the error-code table).

attributes.description: The trait attributes stamped on this piece.

schema.description: Publish an artifact (an Actum for build-order #1) to a destination under a visibility/custody policy. artifact.description: The canonical artifact being published (referenced, never copied).

destination.description: Adapter key (e.g. 'feed'). Defaults from prefs, then 'feed'.

license.description: License tag — 'catalog' (our liability) | a BYO license id. Defaults from prefs, then 'catalog' for platform-canonical artifacts.

teamId.description: Snapshot an equal-weight rights split from a team (Sodalitas) the caller is a member of. Mutually exclusive with owners.

owners.description: Explicit rights split — animaId → weight, weights must sum to 1. Mutually exclusive with teamId. Snapshotted on the Editio as the canonical who-earns record (drives the model-royalty split).
